item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"The answer intercepts `litellm.responses` and drives a real `dspy.LM(..., model_type=\"responses\")` request through DSPy so the inspected payload is the exact post-conversion outbound request, not just the helper's internal input.","span_ids":["e1","e2"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"The LM is configured as an OpenAI reasoning-model Responses API call with `reasoning_effort=\"low\"` and the required reasoning-model settings `temperature=1.0` and `max_tokens=16000` before sending the prompt.","span_ids":["e3","e4"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":35,"statement":"The captured outbound kwargs are checked to confirm DSPy removes the top-level `reasoning_effort` field and emits `reasoning == {\"effort\": \"low\", \"summary\": \"auto\"}` instead.","span_ids":["e5","e6"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"The captured request surfaces the Responses API `input` payload, showing that plain text content is converted into `input_text` blocks rather than leaving a chat-style `messages` payload.","span_ids":["e7","e8"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"e1","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":177,"end_line":190},{"span_id":"e2","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":479,"end_line":492},{"span_id":"e3","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":90,"end_line":105},{"span_id":"e4","path":"tests/clients/test_lm.py","start_line":643,"end_line":648},{"span_id":"e5","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":529,"end_line":533},{"span_id":"e6","path":"tests/clients/test_lm.py","start_line":649,"end_line":651},{"span_id":"e7","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":169,"end_line":170},{"span_id":"e8","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":518,"end_line":528}]}
